tagline: World's leading derivatives and securities exchange network
hero_kpi_rationale: Principal revenue segment of CBOE, representative of its positioning as a global leader in listed options

kpis.name: Options Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from index and equity options trading
kpis.description: Options segment revenue, primary driver of CBOE's business as the largest options exchange operator in the U.S.

kpis.name: Trading Volumes
kpis.explanation: Total trading volumes across all segments and products
kpis.description: Trading volumes indicator of market activity and customer engagement across derivatives and equities segments

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Consolidated operating income from all segments
kpis.description: Operating income metric used by CODM for segment performance evaluation and resource allocation

kpis.name: Strategic Restructuring
kpis.explanation: Wind down and divestiture initiatives to refocus on core businesses
kpis.description: 2025 strategic review led to wind down of Japan equities, CEDX, sales process for Australia and Canada businesses, and discontinuation of Corporate Listings efforts, reflecting portfolio optimization

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Total amount paid in dividends per share over the fiscal year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Annual total: dividends paid + share buybacks.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Share of net income distributed. >80% = potentially unsustainable.

risks.title: Loss of exclusive index options listing and trading rights
risks.score_rationale: Listed first in risk summary with strong language ('material adverse effect'). Loss of exclusive rights to products like S&P 500 index options would directly impact majority of Options segment revenue and overall profitability.

risks.title: Intense price competition and product commoditization
risks.score_rationale: Described with strong language ('intense price competition', 'intensify'). Directly impacts transactional revenue across all segments, with derivatives products increasingly commoditized.

risks.title: Economic, political, and geopolitical market conditions
risks.score_rationale: Listed in risk summary with multiple cited factors. Directly impacts trading volumes and market data revenues which are sensitive to market activity and volatility levels.

risks.title: Cybersecurity vulnerabilities and system failures
risks.score_rationale: Highlighted in risk summary with references to 'security vulnerabilities and breaches' and ability to 'accommodate trading and clearing volume without failure'. System failures are operationally critical for an exchange.

risks.title: Regulatory and legislative changes
risks.score_rationale: Listed in risk summary ('legal and regulatory obligations', 'legislative or regulatory changes'). Broad impact on operations including market structure rules, tax regimes, and compliance costs.

risks.title: Dependence on third-party service providers
risks.score_rationale: Listed in risk summary ('dependence on and exposure to risk from third parties'). Introduces operational and business continuity risks given CBOE's reliance on external vendors.

risks.title: Loss of key customers and trading volume declines
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in risk summary ('loss of key customers or significant reduction in trading or clearing volumes'). Direct impact on transaction-based revenues which comprise majority of operating income.

ai_positioning.summary: CBOE does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K filing for the year ended December 31, 2025.
